authorization_scope: Owner requests continued iterative Grok handoffs and source-first review; one bounded native core-loop take for this mode. No paid API purchase or timer change.

identity_reference.binding: Bind if available; otherwise consult and record one-image-slot limitation.

requested_settings.audio: request silent; preserve unavoidable original native audio

performance_contract.tail: One connected iridescent tail, broad two-lobed fin; horizontal S-wave in picture plane.
performance_contract.hands: Soft, compact sculling with rounded elbow/wrist recovery coordinated with tail cycle; no visible water.
performance_contract.hair: Loose curl-tip follow-through, not ghost trails or static cutouts.
performance_contract.loop_cut_requirement: Provide actual native neighborhoods before/after proposed endpoints; match torso, arms, hair, tail/fin pose AND direction of motion. Tail bounds/fin extrema alone do not establish full cycles.
performance_contract.left_method: Later whole-sprite mirror of accepted right-facing source.
performance_contract.entry_and_phase_exits: Deferred to separately addressed requests after choosing this core; still required before gameplay acceptance.
performance_contract.phase_contract: Contained propulsion, opposite bend, recovery, return to matching whole-body phase; quarters of one second for slow, quarters of half a second for dash. Preserve expressive ease/eager confidence and natural overlap, not rigid posed repetition.

preserve: Owner-approved painted character/art and acting direction
